item.title: Jets Want To Add Two, Cost-Effective Veteran Quarterbacks, Might Pursue Jarrett Stidham
item.description: According to ESPN’s Rich Cimini, the Jets’ plan at quarterback this offseason is to try to add two veteran quarterbacks, ideally on lower-cost contracts or trades. Broncos backup QB Jarrett Stidham is a specific target Cimini mentions, noting Jets GM Darren Mougey was part of the front office when Stidham was brought to Denver.
